name: The Brief: reader engagement
status: definition only; not created in PostHog

panels.name: Foreground engagement per visit
panels.definition: Sum article_read_time.active_seconds by visit_id; left join article_view visits, filling missing time with zero; report median and view count by article_id/league.

panels.name: 75% article-body exposure
panels.definition: Distinct visit_id with article_scroll.scroll_percent=75 divided by distinct article_view.visit_id for same article/league and window. Show numerator and denominator. Not reading completion.

panels.name: Observed returning browsers
panels.definition: Count distinct_id with page_view or article_view on two or more local calendar dates in window; report alongside all distinct browsers. Not cross-device people or cohort retention.

panels.name: Entry choices
panels.limitation: No impressions collected; this is not CTR.

panels.name: Reel playback
panels.limitation: Autoplay starts and seek-to-end completions possible; no full-watch claim.

sample_policy: Always show counts; under 20 views describe sparse evidence, not winners. This is not a significance threshold.
reporting: Rika interprets results for Cody on request or within existing authorized work; no new schedule.
